feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Zelenskyy sits down with NPR. And, Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer
entry.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has a sit-down interview with NPR as Russia's full-scale invasion nears the 5-year mark. And, Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer.

entry.title: Diplomat Richard Haass discusses the Russia-Ukraine war and Trump's role
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with veteran diplomat Richard Haass about the Russia-Ukraine war and the role President Trump is playing.

entry.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
entry.summary: Factory workers in India are being asked to wear GoPro cameras to record the way they do their jobs. The ultimate goal is to train robots to take over. Will it work?

entry.title: Trump's ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, resigns after allegations of improper conduct
entry.summary: The White House publicly asked for U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle's resignation on Tuesday as she faced mounting accusations of improper conduct.

entry.title: How will a diesel deal with Russia impact the U.S. market?
entry.summary: The price of diesel hit an all-time high in the U.S. in September. Can President Trump's deal for Russia to release more diesel onto the market bring the price down?

entry.title: The Trump administration warns Ukraine it could cut off intel, Zelenskyy tells NPR
entry.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy sat down for an interview with NPR at a time of renewed tensions with the White House.

entry.title: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
entry.summary: The government is using millions of taxpayers' dollars on pro-Trump ads, even after the president said this would not happen. And, federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home.

entry.title: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in former prime minister's stronghold
entry.summary: Pakistan has imposed emergency rule in the province governed by the political party of imprisoned former prime minister Imran Khan.

entry.title: Trump's diesel deal with Putin angers Europe
entry.summary: President Trump's diesel deal with Russia sparks European fury, as Ukraine's President Zelenskyy questions Washington's motives and allies vow to keep pressure on Moscow.

entry.title: How NATO plans to combat potential attacks on the alliance from Russia
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with former U.S. Assistant Secretary for European Affairs Dan Hamilton about NATO's detailed plans to counter any possible Russian attack on the alliance.
